description: Unit: the status derivation returns paid, partially_applied and sent for full, partial and zero net payments; never overwrites draft/cancelled/void; returns sent (not paid) for a zero-payment credit note or negative-total invoice; returns paid for net payments above the balance

DB integration: record a full payment on a finalized invoice, unfinalize it, finalize it again: status is paid, the audit row's after.status is paid, and no credit is applied even when the client has available credit with auto-apply on

DB integration: a paid invoice unfinalized, edited to a higher total and finalized is partially_applied with the right balance due; edited below the amount paid and finalized is paid with a negative balance
DB integration: a freshly generated invoice with no payments still finalizes as sent (regression guard for the recurring-generation and REST callers)
Existing recordExternalPayment dedup/reversal tests pass unchanged against the shared derivation
Component: the draft invoice view shows the amount paid when payments exist, and the overpaid warning when the total is below it
DB integration: the migration flips a finalized sent invoice with full payments to paid, leaves a draft with payments and a correctly-statused invoice untouched
